info.name: SENTA DB Diagnostics
info.description: Read-only checks against every Senta database via GET /api/senta/db-check. Each response lists every check with ok, timing, rows, or the exact Postgres error (message, code, detail, hint). Error codes: 28000 = no pg_hba.conf entry (ask for access), 28P01 = wrong password, 42501 = permission denied, 42P01 = table/view missing, ECONNREFUSED / ETIMEDOUT = port blocked. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner to get a pass/fail list.

exec: if (body.target === 'eod_reports') pm.test('eod_reports dir readable', () => pm.expect(body.ok, body.error && body.error.message).to.be.true);

request.description: Runs every check on every DB. 200 = all OK, 502 = at least one failed. See the Test Results tab for which.
